name: sx-turnover-tax
description: Sint Maarten turnover-tax reference checked in 2026 against the official statute and tax-administration guidance. Covers the five-percent rate, receipts-based timing, authorised invoice accounting, treatment of genuine customer disbursements, monthly returns and selected exemption conditions. Explains the special export boundary encompassing the French side of the island and statutory export-evidence requirements. Includes worked computations and distinguishes exemption from absence of filing duties. Flags conditional recipient liability for overseas suppliers rather than assuming a universal reverse charge. Applies to Dutch Sint Maarten. Complete sector-specific relief, amendment reconciliation and independent accountant review remain outstanding.
